title: Drift Simulation with Hidden Contexts
summary: A streaming tabular data synthesis and concept-drift simulation framework that builds abrupt/gradual/incremental/recurrent drift streams from generator-produced tabular data for classification and regression experiments. It wraps and loads SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer (via sdv.single_table/sdv.metadata) as pluggable tabular generators among several other model types (CTAB-GAN, TabDDPM).
